item.text:
**6B.7 Research Note: AMLO in 2024**

**Verdict**  
Mixed, leaning weakly positive on formal anti-patronage design, but with real patronage-sensitive behavior around election timing and persistent allegations/risk signals.

**Accepted Claims**
- [`Entrega directa de Programas para el Bienestar abate la corrupción`](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/entrega-directa-de-programas-para-el-bienestar-abate-la-corrupcion/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-10-17 | The government said social-program money now goes directly to beneficiaries through Banco del Bienestar cards, with intermediaries and commissions removed. This is strong evidence against using benefits as patronage channels. | IDs: 6B.7, 6B.5
- [`Banco del Bienestar distribuye 26.5 millones de tarjetas para pago de pensiones, becas y apoyos del Gobierno de la 4T`](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/banco-del-bienestar-distribuye-26-5-millones-de-tarjetas-para-pago-de-pensiones-becas-y-apoyos-del-gobierno-de-la-4t/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-05 | The administration described large-scale direct payment infrastructure for pensions, scholarships, and supports, with deposits scheduled by beneficiary name. That supports a rules-based delivery model rather than discretionary loyalty rewards. | IDs: 6B.7, 6B.5
- [`Tarjeta del Banco del Bienestar: no caigas en fraudes, no hay campañas de renovación`](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/tarjeta-del-banco-del-bienestar-no-caigas-en-fraudes-no-hay-campanas-de-renovacion/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-09-10 | The government said beneficiaries did not need to renew cards after the transition and that dispersal would continue as usual. This is evidence of continuity and an attempt to keep benefits detached from political turnover. | IDs: 6B.7, 6B.5
- [`Aclaración. El INE promueve la denuncia contra la compra y coacción del voto...`](https://www.gob.mx/ine) | Instituto Nacional Electoral | 2024-04-26 | INE guidance reiterated that programs must not be used to induce or coerce votes and that authorities can sanction misuse. This is not proof of AMLO’s conduct by itself, but it is a strong contemporaneous standard that explicitly treats program politicization as a live risk. | IDs: 6B.7
- [`Versión estenográfica de la Sesión Extraordinaria del Consejo General, 11 de abril de 2024`](https://centralelectoral.ine.mx/2024/04/11/version-estenografica-de-la-sesion-extraordinaria-del-consejo-general-11-de-abril-de-2024/) | Instituto Nacional Electoral | 2024-04-11 | INE participants discussed additional measures to prevent political use of social programs and said the process had seen repeated violations and pressure risks. This is strong negative contextual evidence that patronage concerns were not hypothetical. | IDs: 6B.7
- [`Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral`](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18 | The government said it advanced Jan-Feb payments before the campaign blackout and would make no payments or incorporations during the electoral period. That is explicit evidence of election-sensitive timing, which cuts against a pure non-patronage reading. | IDs: 6B.7, 6B.5
- [`Exigen senadores investigar financiamiento ilegal a campañas de Morena`](https://www.pan.senado.gob.mx/2024/04/exigen-senadores-investigar-financiamiento-ilegal-a-campanas-de-morena/) | PAN Senado | 2024-04-02 | Opposition senators alleged that money from social programs, including illicit sources, was being funneled into Morena’s campaign activity. This is allegation-level evidence, not proof, but it shows the issue was serious enough to be publicly raised. | IDs: 6B.7
- [`Mexico's next president will have to boost tax take to pay for social programs`](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexicos-next-president-will-have-to-boost-tax-take-to-pay-for-social-programs-3467628) | Reuters | 2024-06-03 | Reuters reported an election-year spending binge and a surge in welfare outlays that lifted Mexico’s deficit. This is indirect evidence that welfare policy was politically intensified in the campaign year, even if not proof of targeted punishment or reward. | IDs: 6B.7, 6B.5

**Search Gap**
- I found strong evidence that AMLO’s system was designed to reduce intermediaries and commissions, and strong warnings that social programs could be used politically.
- I did not find solid independent 2024 proof that AMLO systematically withheld benefits from opponents or formally conditioned access on partisan loyalty.
- The clearest negative evidence is timing and risk: pre-blackout payment acceleration, repeated INE warnings, and opposition allegations. That is enough for a mixed judgment, but not enough to prove a fully entrenched patronage machine.
